name: Solid 3D Shapes (VR Game)
summary: In this VR game, players explore an immersive world of solid 3D shapes. The challenge is to identify each shape and place it correctly onto the spot labeled with its name, combining fun with learning. Designed by Olabs, Vidyakash, and the Ministry of Education Technology, the game enhances spatial understanding and cognitive skills through interactive problem-solving in a virtual environment.
